questions.question: Define the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR) and identify its contribution to human security. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• The Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR) is a foundational document adopted
  • by the UN in 1948, establishing universal human rights standards, thus promoting global
  • human security and dignity.

questions.question: Explain how international trade policies affect human security in developing nations. / [CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• International trade policies can either promote economic stability or exacerbate inequalities,
  • affecting job security, access to essential goods, and overall economic resilience in developing
  • nations.

questions.question: Show how UNO security initiatives help prevent human rights violations. / [CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• United Nations -security initiatives include peacekeeping missions - human rights
  • monitoring and humanitarian assistance - help prevent conflicts violence and discrimination in
  • vulnerable regions - promote international cooperation and protection of civilians - support
  • democratic institutions rule of law and enforcement of fundamental human rights standards.

questions.question: Discuss the role of political participation in promoting human security. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Political participation empowers citizens, promotes accountability, and ensures inclusive
  • governance, reducing the risk of conflict and enhancing community security and social
  • cohesion.

questions.question: Analyze the relationship between poverty and human security. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Poverty weakens human security - limiting access to food healthcare education and
  • employment opportunities - increases vulnerability to crime exploitation and social exclusion
  • - creates economic instability and poor living conditions - reduction of poverty improves social
  • welfare human dignity and overall national security.

questions.question: Develop an ethical framework for decision-making in humanitarian interventions. / [CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• An ethical framework for humanitarian interventions prioritizes impartiality, non -
  • discrimination, and the protection of vulnerable populations while respecting sovereignty and
  • minimizing unintended harm.

questions.question: Construct a model explaining how financial institutions promote human security. / [CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• Financial institutions such as World Bank and IMF- provide loans grants and development
  • assistance to countries - support poverty reduction , healthcare, education and infrastructure
  • development - encourage economic stability and employment generation - strengthen human
  • security by improving living standards and reducing social inequalities globally.

questions.question: Discuss how lack of access to nutritious food affects human health and well-being / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Inadequate access to nutritious food impairs physical and cognitive development, increases
  • susceptibility to diseases, and perpetuates poverty, undermining overall health and societal
  • well-being.

questions.question: Describe how pandemics impact global public health. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Pandemics strain healthcare systems, disrupt economies, and expose inequities in access to
  • essential services, leading to widespread health, social, and economic insecurity.

questions.question: Describe how the Paris Agreement aims to mitigate climate change. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Paris Agreement - aims to reduce global greenhouse gas emissions and limit global
  • temperature rise - encourages countries to adopt climate action plans and renewable energy
  • policies - promotes international cooperation financial support and sustainable development -
  • strengthens global efforts to combat climate change and environmental degradation.

questions.question: Examine how deforestation contributes to climate change. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Deforestation accelerates climate change by releasing stored carbon, disrupting ecosystems,
  • and reducing natural carbon sinks, thereby increasing environmental and human vulnerability.

questions.question: Describe the relationship between Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Sustainable Development Goals are part of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development
  • adopted by the United Nations in 2015 - consist of seventeen global goals addressing poverty
  • inequality climate change and peace - provide a framework for sustainable development -
  • promote social economic and environmental progress worldwide.

questions.question: State how political stability or instability affects human security. / [CO1] [5x4 = 20]
questions.solution_html:
• Political stability fosters economic development, social cohesion, and law enforcement,
  • while instability breeds conflict, displacement, and insecurity, undermining human rights and
  • basic needs.

questions.question: Discuss the role of democratic governance in promoting human security. / [CO1] [5x4 = 20]
questions.solution_html:
• Democratic governance- promotes human security through protection of human rights rule
  • of law and public participation - ensures accountability transparency and equal opportunities
  • in society - reduces corruption discrimination and political oppression - strengthens social
  • justice political stability and citizen welfare in democratic nations.

questions.question: Illustrate the role of political decisions in shaping outcomes of human security during natural disasters. / [CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• Political decisions during natural disasters determine resource allocation, emergency
  • response, and recovery efforts -effective governance can mitigate damage and protect
  • vulnerable populations, while poor planning exacerbates human insecurity through inadequate
  • infrastructure, delayed relief, and unequal access to essential services.

questions.question: Demonstrate how digital tools can support transparency and accountability in public health governance. / [CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• Digital tools such as online health portals mobile applications and data dashboards improve
  • transparency in public health governance - enable real time sharing of health information ,
  • disease tracking and vaccination updates - strengthen accountability by monitoring government
  • actions and healthcare delivery systems - promote citizen participation, feedback mechanisms
  • and quicker response during emergencies - help reduce corruption , misinformation and
  • administrative delays in health-care management and policy implementation.

questions.question: Explain the role of WHO in addressing pandemics. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• World Health Organization (WHO) coordinates global pandemic responses by monitoring
  • disease outbreaks, providing guidelines, supporting national health systems, and facilitating
  • vaccine distribution, thereby reducing health disparities and promoting public health security
  • on a global scale.

questions.question: Examine the role of the Human Rights Commission in promoting Human Security in India. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• India’s Human Rights Commission addresses violations, promotes awareness, and
  • recommends policies to protect marginalized communities, ensuring that human rights
  • principles are integrated into national security frameworks and reducing risks of discrimination
  • and abuse.

questions.question: Discuss the influence of politics on the human security policies in the modern cotext. / [CO1] [10x2 = 20]
questions.solution_html:
• Politics shapes human security policies by influencing budget allocations, enforcement of
  • human rights, and prioritization of security threats -power dynamics, political agendas, and
  • international relations impact the implementation and effectiveness of security measures,
  • affecting vulnerable populations.

questions.question: Define human security and explain its key principles. / [CO1] [10x2 = 20]
questions.solution_html:
• Human security- refers to protection of individuals from threats such as poverty violence
  • disease and environmental disasters - focuses on freedom from fear, freedom from want, and
  • human dignity - emphasizes safety, well-being and development of people rather than only
  • state security - includes economic , food, health, environmental, personal, community and
  • political security - promotes human rights , social justice , sustainable development and
  • international cooperation for peaceful and secure societies.
